items.title: Крупные массы
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE finished pixel-art tactical creature roster scene, landscape 4:3. Input image 1 is the user's STYLE and creature roster reference; image 2 is ONLY our camera elevation and character-to-tile placement benchmark; image 3 is ONLY the 4:3 diamond top geometry. Do not copy the benchmark warrior or grass colors. Six recognizable creatures from image 1: a hollow armored knight with a simple shield and short sword (no chain), muscular orange goblin-ogre, teal gelatinous slime, thick purple cobra, rust-red giant rat, stocky grey wolf. Six characters, all in exactly the same front three-quarter isometric facing toward screen lower-right. Faces/chests/muzzles visible, NEVER back views, NEVER mixed facings. Camera looks down enough to see tops of helmets, shoulders and backs, matching image 2. Each creature stands squarely within its own separate cell on ONE continuous flat 4x4 purple stone dungeon grid; leave spare empty cells for clear spacing and no overlaps. Every tile TOP diamond width:height = 4:3 (128:96), not conventional flat 2:1. Tile grid is a continuous thin floor, NO isolated raised tiles, NO plinths, NO round bases, NO stands, NO discs, NO rocks beneath feet, NO black oval base. Feet/paws/slime contact the flat cell surface directly. Small subtle contact shadow only. Bodies centered over their cells using image 2 as placement guide, figures modest relative to cells; no toe crossing a seam. Neutral dark plum background, quiet low-contrast ground. Handcrafted crisp pixel clusters, compact expressive forms, consistent pixel scale, no blur, no painterly rendering, no 3D render, no gradients, no excessive dithering, no text, no logos, no watermark. Design for later AI animation: stable readable body parts, short garments, clear hands and feet, no dangling trinkets or particles. This is a static concept, not an animation sheet. Variation direction: Closest to the reference: chunky sinister dungeon pixel art, large clean clusters, strong dark blue outlines, slate armor, orange ogre, turquoise slime, purple snake, rust rat and grey wolf. Simplify all ornament to broad planes.
